stops.note: to follow, combined with ob- (toward, after)
to comply with, to follow after, from ob- and sequi
stops.meaning: to comply with, to follow after

stops.note: compliant, eager to please, from obsequi
settled as the English word for being excessively eager to please or obey
stops.meaning: excessively eager to please or obey

current_meaning: excessively eager to please or obey someone, in an insincere way
